name: unreal-connector
description: Lets Claude operate your open Unreal Editor: inspect the level, run Python, screenshot the viewport, play, save, and import Daedalus worlds.
long_description: Pairs with the Claude Unreal Bridge, which the DaedalusLink plugin starts inside the Unreal Editor on 127.0.0.1. This extension forwards Claude's tool calls to it. Nothing leaves your computer except what Claude reads back through the tools.

tools.name: unreal_status
tools.description: Check the Unreal Editor is open and the bridge is listening

tools.name: get_level_info
tools.description: List the actors in the open level

tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Run Python in the Unreal Editor

tools.name: save
tools.description: Save the level and changed assets

tools.name: import_daedalus_world
tools.description: Import a Daedalus world from its server, verify it, and frame it

tools.name: frame_daedalus_world
tools.description: Point the viewport at a Daedalus world

port.title: Unreal bridge port
port.description: The port the Claude Unreal Bridge listens on inside the editor (DAEDALUS_BRIDGE_PORT)
